title: Windrow House Rising
author: Quentin Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Whitlock, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
